reason: The cited evidence (E1) concerns a completely different alloy system (VCrFeTaW) and strengthening mechanism (solid-solution and hard Laves phases), providing no support for the specific claims about Nb-induced coherent precipitates, crack bridging, or preservation of magnetostructural transitions in the MM'X alloy. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the provided evidence.
premises: Nb addition to (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 promotes in-situ formation of nanoscale, coherent Nb-rich precipitates along grain boundaries
These precipitates bridge cracks and toughen the material
The precipitates do not significantly perturb the magnetostructural transition responsible for the caloric response
The intervention increases compressive strength above 220 MPa while maintaining caloric response within ~10% of the original
